newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Waterfront rises 12 pct on income news.
newsitem.headline: Waterfront rises 12 pct on income news.

text.p: Hotelier Waterfront Philippines Inc jumped 35 centavos, or 12.07 percent, to 3.25 pesos in midsession on Monday after the company announced its first quarter income, brokers said.
"Their net income for the first quarter of their fiscal year was positive news," said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
"People are expecting their income might hit 200 million pesos for the whole year," said Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities.
Waterfront reported a 36.79 million peso net income in its first quarter ended June.
Waterfront earlier reached a high of 3.30 pesos. A total of 4.52 million shares changed hands in midsession.
